name: Branch
description: A straight fallen branch thick enough to become a haft, spear shaft, firewood, or frame member.
flavor: "A useful branch is already half a tool."

name: Bark
description: Strips of bark rich in tannins, useful for cordage, fire-starting, and preserving hides.
flavor: "The tree gives more than timber."

name: Reeds
description: Long wetland reeds suitable for mats, baskets, thatching, cordage, and kindling.
flavor: "Where the ground is too wet for grass, reeds do the building."

name: Clay
description: Plastic clay dug from damp ground, ready to be shaped and fired.
flavor: "Mud remembers the hands that shaped it."

name: Stone Flake
description: A deliberately struck stone flake with a keen but fragile edge.
flavor: "The first blade needed no forge."

name: Cordage
description: Twisted plant fibers strong enough for bindings, snares, lashings, and primitive tools.
flavor: "Strength made from many weak fibers."

name: Sinew
description: Cleaned tendon fibers valued for compact, very strong bindings and bow work.
flavor: "Pulled from bone, stronger than it looks."

name: Sinew Cord
description: Tightly twisted sinew cord with excellent tensile strength.
flavor: "It dries hard and holds harder."

name: Animal Fat
description: Dense animal fat useful for cooking, soap, sealing, and calorie-rich meals.
flavor: "Winter stores itself under the hide."

name: Offal
description: Nutrient-dense organs that spoil quickly but enrich broths and survival meals.
flavor: "Waste to the careless; strength to the hungry."

name: Fresh Hide
description: Unprocessed hide, heavy with moisture and vulnerable to rot until scraped and preserved.
flavor: "A skin is not leather until work makes it so."

name: Scraped Hide
description: A cleaned hide with flesh and membrane removed, ready for drying or tanning.
flavor: "The blade work shows in every clean patch."

name: Rawhide
description: A stiff dried hide useful for shields, lashings, containers, and hard-wearing camp gear.
flavor: "Hard as old bark when dry, pliable when soaked."

name: Leather
description: Flexible preserved hide suitable for clothing, armor, containers, straps, and fine work.
flavor: "Time, bark, water, and patience make skin endure."

name: Feather
description: A stiff flight feather suitable for arrow fletching, bedding, and decorative work.
flavor: "A small piece of the sky left behind."

name: Crude Knife
description: A sharp stone flake wrapped with bark for a safer grip. Crude, fragile, but sufficient for early carcass work.
flavor: "A wrapped edge is enough to turn a kill into usable food and hide."

name: Stone Knife
description: A flaked stone blade lashed to a short handle. Essential for carcass work and hide preparation.
flavor: "Ugly edges still cut cleanly."

name: Stone Pick
description: A heavy stone head bound to a stout branch for breaking softer rock and opening shallow workings.
flavor: "The mountain yields first to persistence, then to metal."

name: Stone Hammer
description: A rounded stone hammer for construction, crushing bone, and rough craft.
flavor: "Simple weight, carefully directed."

name: Digging Stick
description: A fire-hardened stick used to loosen soil, pry roots, and begin primitive farming.
flavor: "The first plow was a branch and stubborn hands."

name: Stone Hoe
description: A broad stone edge lashed to a handle for turning soil more efficiently than a digging stick.
flavor: "A field begins one broken clod at a time."

name: Fire-Hardened Javelin
description: A straight fire-hardened shaft balanced well enough for a long thrust or a committed throw.
flavor: "Reach first, throw only when the opening is worth losing the shaft."

name: Club
description: A dense branch trimmed into a brutal close-quarters weapon and pounding tool.
flavor: "No edge to dull, only weight to swing."

name: Sling
description: A braided sling that turns smooth stones into useful small-game ammunition.
flavor: "A stone travels farther when the cord lends it speed."

name: Sling Stone
description: A smooth palm-sized stone selected for consistent sling flight.
flavor: "The best ammunition is often underfoot."

name: Primitive Self Bow
description: A simple one-piece hunting bow shaped from a stave and strung with strong cordage. It rewards careful aim more than raw power.
flavor: "A straight stave becomes distance held under tension."

name: Stone Arrow
description: A light shaft with stone point and feather fletching.
flavor: "Straight wood, sharp stone, steady breath."

name: Bone Awl
description: A polished bone point for piercing leather, bark, and woven material.
flavor: "A little point opens the way for thread."

name: Bone Needle
description: A fine drilled bone needle for stitched leather, cloth, and careful repairs.
flavor: "Small enough to lose, important enough to mourn."

name: Rawhide Buckler
description: A compact wooden-and-rawhide hand shield built for quick interceptions without much missile coverage.
flavor: "Small enough to move first; large enough to matter."

name: Clay Pot
description: A fire-safe clay pot for stews, broths, porridges, boiling water, and rendering fat.
flavor: "A pot turns scattered ingredients into a meal."

name: Bowl
description: A carved bowl for eating meals, collecting ingredients, and simple camp use.
flavor: "The shape of hunger answered in wood."

name: Small Game Meat
description: Lean meat from rabbit, hare, or similar small game. Best cooked before eating.
flavor: "Small prey feeds a careful hunter."

name: Game Meat
description: Dense red meat from deer, elk, boar, or other large game.
flavor: "A day of tracking condensed into a heavy cut of meat."

name: Poultry
description: Light meat from wild birds, tender but quick to spoil.
flavor: "Feathers on the ground, supper in the pot."

name: Dried Meat
description: Thin strips of meat dried until light, chewy, and resistant to spoilage.
flavor: "Hard travel food that asks only strong teeth."

name: Blueberries
description: Dark wild berries with tart sweetness and useful moisture.
flavor: "A handful stains the fingers and brightens a lean meal."

name: Raspberries
description: Soft red berries that bruise easily and reward careful gathering.
flavor: "Sweet enough that birds always arrive first."

name: Strawberries
description: Small fragrant berries growing close to sunny ground.
flavor: "Tiny fruit with a summer larger than itself."

name: Dandelion
description: Bitter young greens that add fiber and vitamins to soups and stews.
flavor: "The weed survives because it knows the world better than gardeners do."

name: Nettle
description: Stinging leaves that become edible when cooked and useful as coarse fiber when processed.
flavor: "Handle badly and it bites; handle well and it feeds."

name: Wild Onion
description: Sharp wild bulbs that flavor meals and can yield seed for cultivation.
flavor: "A small bulb with enough scent to announce dinner."

name: Wild Carrot
description: A pale tough root, less sweet than cultivated carrot but dependable.
flavor: "Pulled from stubborn ground, still worth the dirt under the nails."

name: Yarrow
description: A pungent flowering herb traditionally valued in field dressings and bitter infusions.
flavor: "White flowers above, old fieldcraft below."

name: Plantain
description: Broad resilient leaves useful in simple poultices and herb mixtures.
flavor: "It grows where boots pass and survives because of it."

name: Morel
description: A honeycombed woodland mushroom, valuable cooked and risky to waste.
flavor: "The forest hides good food in shapes that look improbable."

name: Bolete
description: A firm woodland mushroom well suited to broths and stews.
flavor: "A quiet cap beneath old trees."

name: Wild Grain
description: Loose heads of wild cereal grain, sparse but enough to seed the first field.
flavor: "Civilization begins when someone saves a handful instead of eating it."

name: Cattail Root
description: A starchy wetland rhizome that becomes much more pleasant after cooking.
flavor: "The marsh keeps its starch underground."

name: Barley Seed
description: Seed saved for planting barley.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Barley
description: Harvested barley suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Bean Seed
description: Seed saved for planting field beans.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Beans
description: Harvested field beans suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Cabbage Seed
description: Seed saved for planting cabbage.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Cabbage
description: Harvested cabbage suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Carrot Seed
description: Seed saved for planting carrot.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Carrot
description: Harvested carrot suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Onion Seed
description: Seed saved for planting onion.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Onion
description: Harvested onion suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Flax Seed
description: Seed saved for planting flax seed.
flavor: "A future field carried in the palm."

name: Flax
description: Harvested flax seed suitable for cooking, storage, and seed-saving.
flavor: "A field turns weather and soil into something you can carry."

name: Copper Ore
description: Green- and rust-stained copper-bearing rock from a mineral vein.
flavor: A promising vein mineral whose metal can be worked below iron temperatures.

name: Copper Ingot
description: A cast ingot of refined copper, soft enough for early metalworking.
flavor: Warm red metal carrying the first clear step beyond stone tools.

name: Basket
description: A tightly woven reed basket ready to be placed as lightweight camp storage.
flavor: "A hundred bends turn reeds into order."

name: Storage Box
description: A fitted wooden box that can be placed as sturdy camp or household storage.
flavor: "Dry boards, square corners, fewer things lost in the dark."

name: Duckweed
description: Tiny floating freshwater plants gathered as emergency greens and animal feed.
flavor: A handful of green gathered from quiet water.

name: Water Lily Root
description: A starchy rhizome dug from shallow freshwater lilies.
flavor: Mud hides more food than the surface suggests.

name: Pickerelweed
description: A wetland plant with edible young shoots and seeds.
flavor: The wetland offers food where dry ground ends.

name: Saltmarsh Grass
description: Tough salt-tolerant marsh grass useful as coarse fiber and bedding.
flavor: Salt, wind, and tide have made every blade stubborn.

name: Eelgrass
description: Long submerged blades forming productive estuary and coastal grass beds.
flavor: A submerged meadow pulled from brackish water.

name: Kelp
description: Large marine algae gathered from shallow coastal water.
flavor: The sea grows forests where no axe can stand.

name: Earthworms
description: Live worms kept damp for reliable freshwater bait.
flavor: Good bait begins under damp soil.

name: Copper Spoon Lure
description: A flashing reusable copper lure effective on predatory fish.
flavor: A flash of copper can look alive underwater.

name: Reed Fishing Rod
description: A flexible improvised rod suited to small and moderate fish.
flavor: Simple tackle turns patient water into opportunity.

name: Wood Fishing Rod
description: A shaped wooden rod with better leverage and fish control.
flavor: A balanced rod gives the angler room to fight.

name: Fiber Fishing Line
description: Plant-fiber line suitable for small fish but prone to breaking under heavy strain.
flavor: Light line rewards finesse and punishes greed.

name: Sinew Fishing Line
description: Strong prepared sinew line able to handle medium fish.
flavor: Tendon twisted tight enough to trust with a fish.

name: Braided Fishing Line
description: Tightly braided line for large, hard-fighting fish.
flavor: Heavy line for fish that do not intend to be landed.

name: Fishing Spear
description: A light multi-purpose spear balanced for striking fish in shallow water.
flavor: Shallow water leaves only one chance at a clean strike.

name: Fishing Net
description: A hand-cast woven net effective on schooling fish in shallow water.
flavor: A school can escape a hook but not always a well-thrown net.

name: Brook Trout
description: Fresh brook trout from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Cold clear water made this fish quick and bright.

name: Bluegill
description: Fresh bluegill from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Small water can still provide a dependable meal.

name: Largemouth Bass
description: Fresh largemouth bass from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: It waits beside cover until prey makes one mistake.

name: Channel Catfish
description: Fresh channel catfish from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Deep water and scent guide a fish that rarely needs light.

name: Common Carp
description: Fresh common carp from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Heavy, wary, and stronger than its quiet feeding suggests.

name: Northern Pike
description: Fresh northern pike from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: A green shadow built for one sudden strike.

name: Striped Bass
description: Fresh striped bass from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Current and salt pull this fish across whole watersheds.

name: Summer Flounder
description: Fresh summer flounder from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: The bottom itself seems to move when it strikes.

name: Striped Mullet
description: Fresh striped mullet from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Silver schools turn together in shallow coastal water.

name: Atlantic Mackerel
description: Fresh atlantic mackerel from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: A fast silver fish that arrives with the moving sea.

name: Atlantic Cod
description: Fresh atlantic cod from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: Cold deep water carries a heavy fish close to the bottom.

name: Red Drum
description: Fresh red drum from local waters. Individual catch size and quality are recorded by the fishing system.
flavor: A bronze-sided fighter from warm estuaries and surf.

name: Beachgrass
description: Tough dune grass useful as coarse fiber and thatching.
flavor: Thin blades hold dunes together one root at a time.

name: Blue Mussels
description: Edible shellfish gathered from exposed rocky shore beds.
flavor: A meal sealed shut and fastened to the rocks.

name: Wicker Shield
description: A broad woven shield over a light wooden frame. It covers more of the body than a buckler but gives way under heavy impacts.
flavor: "A wall made from reeds still changes where the blow lands."

name: Wooden Round Shield
description: A layered round wooden shield with a central grip, balancing useful coverage with enough mobility for close fighting.
flavor: "Broad timber turns a clean hit into a problem of angles."

name: Hide Kite Shield
description: An elongated wood-and-hide shield that protects the torso and leading leg while trading away some agility.
flavor: "Length below the hand keeps teeth and points farther from the thigh."

name: Iron Heater Shield
description: A compact iron-faced shield with strong structure and high frontal protection against both blows and projectiles.
flavor: "Weight buys certainty when the impact arrives."

name: Steel Tower Shield
description: A very large steel-reinforced shield providing exceptional frontal missile and body coverage at a severe weight and stamina cost.
flavor: "Carry the wall, and accept that the wall carries you too."

name: Flour
description: Stone-ground flour used by bakers and household cooks.

name: Rustic Bread
description: A dense settlement loaf baked from milled flour.

name: Woven Cloth
description: Tightly woven cloth for clothing, furnishings, bandaging, and trade.

name: Small Ale
description: A weak grain-and-fruit ale produced from farm surplus.

name: Dressed Stone
description: Squared stone prepared for durable walls, roads, and civic construction.

name: Smoked Fish
description: Cleaned fish preserved over low smoke for transport and storage.
